lines.en: label sanadorm30:
: Hey, Sana. Are you around?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sana。你在吗？

lines.en: I knock on Sana’s door and instantly hear the volume from her TV turned down a few notches.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Sana 的门，立刻听见她电视的音量被调低了几格。

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : Correct. What other male would be visiting you in the middle of the night?
lines.zh: : 正是。大半夜的，还会有哪个男人来找你？

lines.en: : Maybe it’s my...secret boyfriend...
lines.zh: : 也许是……我秘密交往的男朋友……

lines.en: : Don’t joke about things like that. My heart isn’t prepared for it.
lines.zh: : 别拿这种事开玩笑。我的心脏承受不起。

lines.en: I can hear her giggle in response as she mutes whatever show she’s watching, followed by the faint tapping of her footsteps as she comes to the door.
lines.zh: 我听见她咯咯一笑，把正在看的节目静音，接着是她走到门边时轻微的脚步声。

lines.en: : You can come in...
lines.zh: : 你进来吧……

lines.en: scene black
I pull open the door and walk into Sana’s room to find it devoid of virtually all light save the glow of the TV and a few stray rays of moonlight creeping in through the blinds.
lines.zh: 我拉开门走进 Sana 的房间，屋里几乎没有一丝光，只剩电视的荧光和几缕透过百叶窗溜进来的月光。

lines.en: scene sanatv1
: I’m not interrupting anything, am I?
lines.zh: : 我没打扰到你吧？

lines.en: : You are...but it’s okay.
lines.zh: : 你打扰到了……不过没关系。

lines.en: : I was just watching a movie.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚只是在看电影。

lines.en: : No Ayane tonight?
lines.zh: : 今晚 Ayane 不在？

lines.en: : Is that...why you’re here?
lines.zh: : 那就是……你来的原因？

lines.en: : If I was here to see Ayane, why would I have shouted your name when I knocked on the door?
lines.zh: : 我要是来找 Ayane 的，敲门的时候干嘛要喊你的名字？

lines.en: scene sanatv2
: Good point...
lines.zh: : 说得也是……

lines.en: : But yes...no Ayane. She had to go home for something tonight.
lines.zh: : 不过嗯……Ayane 不在。她今晚有点事得回家一趟。

lines.en: : Home as in...Amamiya mansion-home?
lines.zh: : 家是指……Amamiya 家大宅那种家？

lines.en: : That...is her home, so yes...
lines.zh: : 那……就是她的家，所以嗯……

lines.en: : Oh. Well hey, that just means more time for the two of us to be alone together, right?
lines.zh: : 哦。那这不正好意味着我们两个有更多独处的时间了吗？

lines.en: scene sanatv3
: Right...so no funny business.
lines.zh: : 对……所以不许乱来。

lines.en: : But being alone is the best possible time for funny business.
lines.zh: : 可独处正是乱来的最佳时机啊。

lines.en: : The lights are off and everything.
lines.zh: : 灯都关了，条件齐全。

lines.en: scene sanatv4
: If you’re going to be in that kind of mood...maybe it’s best if I just watch my movie alone...
lines.zh: : 要是你抱着那种心思……也许我还是一个人看电影比较好……

lines.en: : Wait, no. I’ll be good. I promise.
lines.zh: : 等等，别。我会乖乖的，我保证。

lines.en: scene sanatv5
: You better be...this is one of my favorite movies...
lines.zh: : 你最好是这样……这可是我最喜欢的电影之一……

lines.en: : I’ve seen it a million times so we can still talk but...
lines.zh: : 我都看过无数遍了，所以我们还是可以说话，不过……

lines.en: : Try to touch me and I’ll...cut your hands off...
lines.zh: : 你要是敢碰我，我就……把你的手砍下来……

lines.en: : Don’t tell me you’ve been hanging around Yumi now, too, have you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是最近也跟 Yumi 混在一起了吧？

lines.en: : Actually, wait. She would have threatened to cut something else off instead.
lines.zh: 等等，不对。她威胁要砍的应该是别的东西。

lines.en: scene sanatv2
: Is it...okay if I sit back down now? Or do you want to keep talking about Yumi?...
lines.zh: : 我……现在可以坐下了吗？还是你想继续聊 Yumi？……

lines.en: : Oh, feel free. I’m perfectly content with never bringing her up again.
lines.zh: : 哦，随便坐。我巴不得以后再也不提她。

lines.en: : That sounds...kind of rude. But I get it..
lines.zh: : 这听起来……有点刻薄。不过我懂……

lines.en: scene sanatv6
Sana hops onto her bed and curls up into a ball, nearly knocking over the plate of food in front of her.
lines.zh: Sana 跳上床蜷成一团，差点把她面前那盘食物打翻。

lines.en: Her eyes immediately focus in on her movie where-
lines.zh: 她的目光立刻锁定在电影上，就在这时——

lines.en: : Why is that guy sawing off his leg?
lines.zh: : 那个人为什么在锯自己的腿？

lines.en: : It’s the only way he can free himself.
lines.zh: : 这是他唯一能脱身的办法。

lines.en: : I feel like there has to be an easier way to do that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得应该有更简单的办法吧。

lines.en: : Well...there {i}was{/i}. But it kind of went down the drain at the start of the movie...
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}本来是有的{/i}。不过在电影开头就泡汤了……

lines.en: : Oh...I see.
lines.zh: : 哦……这样啊。

lines.en: : That would be...a really funny joke for anyone who’s seen this before...
lines.zh: : 对看过这片子的人来说，这应该是……一个很好笑的梗……

lines.en: : I don’t doubt it.
lines.zh: : 我毫不怀疑。

lines.en: : I had no idea you were into stuff like this, though, Sana.
lines.zh: : 不过我真不知道你喜欢这种东西，Sana。

lines.en: scene sanatv7
: I love horror movies! They’re my...absolute favorite!
lines.zh: : 我超爱恐怖片！它们是我……绝对的最爱！

lines.en: : Ayane and I try to watch one together every weekend when she isn’t with Ami and Maya.
lines.zh: : 只要 Ayane 没和 Ami、Maya 在一起，我和她每个周末都会一起看一部。

lines.en: : And on the nights she is, I’m guessing you just watch them alone?
lines.zh: : 那她和她们在一起的时候，你就是一个人看？

lines.en: scene sanatv8
: Well, yes...But you don’t need to make me feel like a loser because of it...
lines.zh: : 嗯，是的……不过你也不用因此让我觉得自己很失败……

lines.en: : Oh, I wasn’t trying to. I’d be more than happy to come over and watch stuff like this with you when your normal partner is away.
lines.zh: : 哦，我没有那个意思。你的固定搭档不在的时候，我很乐意过来陪你看这种片子。

lines.en: scene sanatv7
: Really?!
lines.zh: : 真的吗？！

lines.en: : I mean...Rin already said she wouldn’t mind coming either but...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……Rin 也说过她不介意来，不过……

lines.en: : On days that both her and Ayane can’t make it, I’ll keep you in mind!
lines.zh: : 等她和 Ayane 都没空的时候，我会想到你的！

lines.en: : Well...thank you for making me your second backup plan?
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢你把我当成二号替补？

lines.en: : Of course!
lines.zh: : 当然！

lines.en: scene sanatv9
: I’m glad you don’t think it’s weird, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴你觉得这不奇怪……

lines.en: : Some people see stuff like...gore and...blood and whatnot and they get scared or grossed out.
lines.zh: : 有些人看到……血腥啊……血啊之类的东西，会害怕或者觉得恶心。

lines.en: : But none of that bothers me at all. I actually really like blood.
lines.zh: : 可这些我一点都不在意。我其实还挺喜欢血的。

lines.en: scene sanatv10
: Oh, but I mean like...movie blood. And video game blood, too, thanks to Rin.
lines.zh: : 哦，不过我说的是……电影里的血。还有游戏里的血，这得感谢 Rin。

lines.en: : I had no idea how much I’d like shooting people until she showed me the light.
lines.zh: : 在她为我指点迷津之前，我都不知道自己会这么喜欢开枪打人。

lines.en: : Real blood is still kind of gross, though.
lines.zh: : 不过真的血还是有点恶心。

lines.en: : I would certainly hope you weren’t also intrigued by the blood of real human beings.
lines.zh: : 我当然希望你不是对真人的血也感兴趣。

lines.en: : I was beginning to think that whole thing about cutting off my hands might be true.
lines.zh: : 我刚才都开始怀疑，你说要砍掉我的手可能是认真的了。

lines.en: scene sanatv11
: Heheh...maybe it is?...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……也许是呢？……

lines.en: : People can get crazy ideas from watching movies and playing games, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 人是会从电影和游戏里学来疯狂念头的，Sensei……

lines.en: : Do you have...any idea how many lives I have watched end? How many I’ve taken myself?...
lines.zh: : 你知不知道……我亲眼看过多少条生命终结？我自己又亲手夺走过多少条？……

lines.en: : You know, it’s finally starting to make sense why you chose the ogre warrior in that game you guys played on the beach.
lines.zh: : 说起来，我总算明白你们在海边玩的那个游戏里，你为什么会选食人魔战士了。

lines.en: scene sanatv12
: I wasn’t an ogre warrior...I was an orc barbarian...
lines.zh: : 我选的不是食人魔战士……是兽人野蛮人……

lines.en: : Aren’t they the same thing?
lines.zh: : 那不是一回事吗？

lines.en: : No. Ogres have layers.
lines.zh: : 不一样。食人魔是有层次的。

lines.en: : What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : Like an onion. Layers...
lines.zh: : 就像洋葱。一层一层的……

lines.en: : ...Yeah, I still don’t get it.
lines.zh: : ……嗯，我还是没懂。

lines.en: scene sanatv9
: Then we’ve got another movie to watch after this one...
lines.zh: : 那我们看完这部还有一部要看……

lines.en: : The next one isn’t really scary, though.
lines.zh: : 不过下一部其实不怎么吓人。

lines.en: : Unless you’re afraid of donkeys...
lines.zh: : 除非你怕驴……

lines.en: : They’re actually my biggest fear.
lines.zh: : 其实驴是我最害怕的东西。

lines.en: scene sanatv13
: Really?...That’s strange...Did something happen with a donkey when you were younger?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗？……好奇怪……你小时候是不是被驴怎么样过？……

lines.en: : Sana, I was obviously kidding.
lines.zh: : Sana，我明显是在开玩笑。

lines.en: scene sanatv14
: B-But...you sounded so serious!
lines.zh: : 可……可你听起来好认真！

lines.en: : And the look in your eyes clearly said “I hate donkeys!”
lines.zh: : 而且你的眼神明明白白写着“我讨厌驴！”

lines.en: : My biggest fear is dying. Donkeys are like, seventh on the list.
lines.zh: : 我最怕的是死亡。驴大概排第七吧。

lines.en: scene sanatv12
: Everyone is afraid of dying...that doesn’t count.
lines.zh: : 每个人都怕死啊……那个不算。

lines.en: : I’m moving donkeys up to sixth place.
lines.zh: : 那我把驴提到第六位。

lines.en: : If that’s what makes you happy, feel free.
lines.zh: : 只要你开心，随便你。

lines.en: : It would make me happier if they were first place and you didn’t lie to me...
lines.zh: : 要是它们排第一、你也没骗我，我会更开心……

lines.en: : Why are you so upset about this? I lie to you all the time.
lines.zh: : 你为什么为这事这么在意？我骗你的次数多了去了。

lines.en: scene sanatv14
: What?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！为什么？！

lines.en: : What did I ever do to you?!
lines.zh: : 我到底对你做了什么？！

lines.en: : Again, I’m only kidding...
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我只是开玩笑……

lines.en: : When is Rin going to teach you about picking up on peoples’ cues?
lines.zh: : Rin 什么时候才教你读懂别人的暗示啊？

lines.en: : She seems to have been doing a fine job in coaxing you out of your shell, but you’ve clearly still got a ways to go.
lines.zh: : 她似乎很擅长把你从壳里哄出来，但显然你还有很长的路要走。

lines.en: scene sanatv15
: Leave me alone. I like my shell...
lines.zh: : 别管我。我喜欢我的壳……

lines.en: : Tortoises live for...hundreds of years, you know...
lines.zh: : 乌龟能活……好几百年呢，你知道吗……

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how often they come out of their shells? Never.
lines.zh: : 你知道它们多久从壳里出来一次吗？从来不出来。

lines.en: : Also, tortoises aren’t...pressured to make friends with all of the other tortoises...
lines.zh: : 而且乌龟……不会被逼着跟所有其他乌龟交朋友……

lines.en: : Do tortoises even understand the concept of friendship?
lines.zh: : 乌龟真的懂得友情这个概念吗？

lines.en: : Probably...they’re wise and...have plenty of time to learn.
lines.zh: : 大概懂吧……它们很有智慧，而且……有大把时间去学。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Sorry for telling you that you still have a ways to go.
lines.zh: : 好好好。抱歉，我不该说你还有很长的路要走。

lines.en: : You’ve improved a lot. Really.
lines.zh: : 你进步很大了。真的。

lines.en: scene sanatv9
: Well...thanks...But I was only kidding anyway.
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢……不过我刚才也是开玩笑的。

lines.en: : If my teacher says that I should become more social, I owe it to him to do that...
lines.zh: : 既然我的老师说我要变得更合群，那我就该照做……

lines.en: : Why are you talking about your teacher in third person? {i}I'm{/i} your teacher. And I’m right here.
lines.zh: : 你为什么用第三人称说你的老师？{i}我就是{/i}你老师啊。而且我就在这儿。

lines.en: scene sanatv16
: Obviously because it’s embarrassing...
lines.zh: : 当然是因为太难为情了……

lines.en: : I embarrassed myself enough the last time you saw me drinking...
lines.zh: : 上次你看到我喝酒的时候，我已经够丢人的了……

lines.en: : I need a cooldown period before I’m able to do something like that again...
lines.zh: : 我得先缓一缓，才能再做那样的事……

lines.en: : I’m not really sure how getting drunk and opening up about yourself is as embarrassing as thanking me for being your teacher, but sure.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白喝醉了向你敞开心扉，怎么会和感谢你当我的老师一样难为情，不过随你吧。

lines.en: : Everything is embarrassing if it’s something you’re not used to saying...or doing...
lines.zh: : 只要是你不习惯说出口……或者不习惯做的事，都会让人难为情……

lines.en: : Even now, I’m embarrassed just to be sitting next to you...
lines.zh: : 就连现在，光是坐在你旁边我都觉得难为情……

lines.en: : I can’t even eat my dinner because...my hands are shaking so much...
lines.zh: : 我连晚饭都吃不了，因为……我的手抖得厉害……

lines.en: Now that she mentions it, I can notice that she's quivering, albeit only slightly.
lines.zh: 她这么一说，我才注意到她确实在发抖，尽管只是轻微的。

lines.en: Having her hands tucked into her sleeves definitely helps hide it, but knowing that it’s going on has made it incredibly more apparent.
lines.zh: 她把双手缩进袖子里确实有助于遮掩，可一旦知道这件事，它就变得格外明显了。

lines.en: : Should I get off of the bed? I know you always prefer to sit on the couch when we’re together.
lines.zh: : 我要不要从床上下来？我知道我们在一起的时候你总是更喜欢坐沙发。

lines.en: : No, it’s okay...
lines.zh: : 不，没关系……

lines.en: : As long as you count this toward my tortoise.
lines.zh: : 只要你把这次算在我的乌龟账上就行。

lines.en: : I mean shell.
lines.zh: : 我是说壳。

lines.en: : Count it toward my shell.
lines.zh: : 算在我的壳上。

lines.en: : The...thing I’m coming out of.
lines.zh: : 就是那个……我正在往外钻的东西。

lines.en: : Right...
scene sanatv17
: I’m not doing a very good job, am I?
lines.zh: : 我做得不怎么样，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m not here to judge. I’m just here to talk to my favorite closet-horror freak and watch some guy chop his appendages off.
lines.zh: : 我不是来评判你的。我只是来陪我最喜欢的、藏在柜子里的恐怖片狂热粉聊聊天，顺便看某个家伙把自己的四肢砍下来。

lines.en: : Normal teacher stuff.
lines.zh: : 正常的老师行为。

lines.en: scene sanatv18
: Heheh...Yeah. Normal teacher stuff.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……是啊。正常的老师行为。

lines.en: The two of us sit in silence for another few moments as the movie carries on.
lines.zh: 电影继续放着，我们两个又沉默地坐了一会儿。

lines.en: Even though she’s constantly draped in black and her wall is covered in spider stickers, it’s definitely a little weird seeing Sana’s eyes light up every time a closeup of something gory happens on the screen.
lines.zh: 尽管她总是浑身黑衣、墙上贴满蜘蛛贴纸，但每次屏幕上出现血腥特写时 Sana 的眼睛都会亮起来，这确实有点诡异。

lines.en: She’s like a kid in a candy shop. Just she’s a little past kid-age and the candy is dismembered body parts.
lines.zh: 她就像进了糖果店的小孩。只不过她已经过了小孩子的年纪，而糖果是残肢断臂。

lines.en: But hey. To each their own, I guess.
lines.zh: 不过嘛。各有所好，我想。

lines.en: I’m into [teenage]girls and Sana’s into dead people.
lines.zh: 我喜欢 [teenage] 女孩，Sana 喜欢死人。

lines.en: That’s just the way the cookie crumbles.
lines.zh: 事情本来就是这个样子。

lines.en: : You’re...a good second backup, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你是个……很称职的二号替补，Sensei……

lines.en: : Thanks for watching the movie with me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你陪我看电影。

lines.en: : Things like this...are a lot more fun when you have friends with you.
lines.zh: : 这种事……有朋友在旁边会有趣得多。

lines.en: : Like you said before, feel free to reach out whenever everyone else can’t make it.
lines.zh: : 就像你之前说的，其他人来不了的时候随时找我。

lines.en: : I’ll drop whatever I’m doing and the two of us can watch more people disfigure themselves in order to survive.
lines.zh: : 我会放下手头的一切，我们两个一起看更多人为求生把自己弄得残缺不全。

lines.en: : That’s the most...romantic thing anyone has ever said to me...
lines.zh: : 这是……有人对我说过最浪漫的话了……

lines.en: : Well try not to fall too hard, got it?
lines.zh: : 那可别陷得太深哦，明白吗？

lines.en: scene sanatv19
: Heheh...in your dreams...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……做梦去吧……

lines.en: : Are you winking at me? I really can’t tell with your hair in the way, but I think you are.
lines.zh: : 你在对我眨眼吗？你头发挡着，我真的看不清，不过我觉得你是在眨眼。

lines.en: scene sanatv17
: Umm...yeah...I was winking...
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯……我是在眨眼……

lines.en: : I guess I should probably cut my hair soon, huh?...
lines.zh: : 我想我大概该找个时间把头发剪了，是吧？……

lines.en: : Even my facial expressions are becoming hard to read...
lines.zh: : 连我的表情都变得难懂了……

lines.en: : Communication is difficult enough as-is...
lines.zh: : 沟通本来就够难的了……

lines.en: : Please don’t cut your hair. I think you’re adorable this way.
lines.zh: : 别剪头发。我觉得你现在这样很可爱。

lines.en: scene sanatv14
: Ah! Bed! Compliments! No! Bad!
lines.zh: : 啊！床！夸奖！不行！坏！

lines.en: scene black
The movie comes to an end not long after that and, just like she said she would, Sana puts on the movie that is meant to introduce me to ogres.
lines.zh: 没过多久电影就放完了，而 Sana 也如她所说，换上了那部要向我介绍食人魔的电影。

lines.en: After roughly thirty minutes, I come to the conclusion that I would much prefer horror movies over whatever this is.
lines.zh: 大概三十分钟后，我得出了一个结论：比起这玩意儿，我宁愿看恐怖片。

lines.en: Also, donkeys move up several spots on my list of most-feared things.
lines.zh: 另外，驴在我最害怕的东西排行榜上蹿升了好几位。

lines.en: Oh, and this happens as well.
lines.zh: 哦，还有这么一档子事。

lines.en: scene sanatv20
Sana winds up passing out very early on and eventually, albeit unconsciously, finds her way into my lap.
lines.zh: Sana 很早就睡了过去，最后虽然没有意识，却还是一路躺到了我的腿上。

lines.en: It was easy to tell she was going to pass out sooner or later, given that her head kept bumping into my shoulder while she was nodding off.
lines.zh: 她迟早会睡着是很容易看出来的，因为她打着盹，脑袋不停地撞到我肩膀上。

lines.en: And each time that happened, she’d apologize and say it was just an accident.
lines.zh: 而每次撞到，她都会道歉，说那只是不小心。

lines.en: Well, in the end, it appears that she ran out of accidents and now my hand is falling asleep as her body is cutting off the blood flow I need to keep it running.
lines.zh: 嗯，到最后，她似乎把不小心都用完了，现在我的手正被压得发麻，因为她的身体切断了我维持它运转所需的血流。

lines.en: Woe is me, I guess.
lines.zh: 我可真惨啊，我想。

lines.en: I’m impressed that I can still find something to complain about even with a cute girl asleep on top of me.
lines.zh: 我都佩服自己，明明有个可爱的女孩睡在我身上，我居然还能找到可抱怨的事。

lines.en: scene black
I somehow manage to make it through the movie.
lines.zh: 我总算把这部电影看完了。

lines.en: Sana never wakes up.
lines.zh: Sana 一直没醒。

lines.en: Well, not while I’m there, at least.
lines.zh: 至少我在的时候没醒过。

lines.en: I imagine she’ll wake up tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我想她明天会醒过来。

lines.en: It would be a real bummer if she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 如果她不醒，那可真是糟透了。

lines.en: How would I explain that to the police?
lines.zh: 那我要怎么跟警察解释？

lines.en: I manage to get her off of me without waking her up and pull her blanket over her.
lines.zh: 我总算把她从我身上挪开、没吵醒她，又替她盖好了被子。

lines.en: And, last but not least-
lines.zh: 最后，但同样重要的是——

lines.en: I box up the dinner she never ate and take it home with me as a reward for learning about ogres.
lines.zh: 我把她一口没动的晚餐打包带走，当作学习食人魔知识的报酬。
